name: Giant Slug — "landwalk of the chosen type" only when fired, with the chosen type
notes: "{5}: At the beginning of your next upkeep, choose a basic land type. This creature gains landwalk of the chosen type until the end of that turn." The landwalk catch-all read the activated ability's effect as a static global "Landwalk" grant on the permanent, and the fired ability gave a bare "Landwalk". The catch-all now skips activated effects and "landwalk of the chosen type"; the fired ability asks for the land type and grants that landwalk to its source only.
